subject.title: Bug: Feishu DM Session Enters Infinite Loop After Subagent Announce Trigger

question: Should the remaining work be a generic subagent/session guard for autonomous completion handoffs, a Feishu-specific live repro and channel fix, or closure after current-main proof shows the loop is gone?
rationale: The source shows partial mitigations and an active direct-handoff path, but choosing between a generic autonomous-run guard, Feishu channel policy, or proof-only closure changes core agent/session behavior and needs owner intent.

options.title: Require live replay then choose guard
options.body: Keep this open, run a current-main Feishu subagent replay, and use the result to decide whether to add a generic completion-handoff guard or a channel-specific repair.

options.title: Fold into Feishu queue incident
options.body: Treat this as a partial overlap with the broader Feishu slow-run issue and close only if that canonical plan explicitly covers the subagent announce-to-DIRECT trajectory.

options.title: Close after proof only
options.body: Close as implemented only if maintainers can provide current-main proof that subagent announces no longer create userless DIRECT runs in Feishu DM sessions.

recommendation.title: Require live replay then choose guard
recommendation.body: Keep this open, run a current-main Feishu subagent replay, and use the result to decide whether to add a generic completion-handoff guard or a channel-specific repair.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision centers on current subagent delivery-state behavior more than the already-shipped Feishu self-filter.
